title: Influence of carbon and fluorine on potassium niobate anode material for sodium-ion battery applications
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2217-2227
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00071H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Y. Bhaskara Rao, C. André Ohlin
Fluorine-doped carbon-coated potassium niobate enhances sodium-ion battery performance, achieving high capacity (173 mA h g−1), improved rate capability, and 90% retention after 200 cycles, attributed to improved conductivity and Na+ diffusion.
